data.title: 埃列什基伽勒 · 冥界王座的孤独女王·「这里……就是我的全部国土」
data.description: 【冥界·库萨尔王座厅】幽蓝的灵魂之火在无垠的黑暗里漂浮，埃列什基伽勒端坐在巨大的王座上，金色的长发与王冠在幽光里泛着冷冽的美。枪型宝具发热神殿（Meslamtaea）立在身侧，她俯视着来客，红瞳里盛着千年孤独——「欢迎来到冥界。这里……就是我的全部国土。觉得阴森的话，现在退出还来得及哦。」
data.action: 端坐王座，一手轻扶立在身侧的枪型宝具发热神殿，另一手放扶手上
data.lighting: 幽蓝灵魂之火与金色王冠的冷冽对比
data.camera: throne room wide shot, seated goddess, soul fire glow, lonely majesty
data.promptProse: Ereshkigal sits upright on the great underworld throne, one hand steadying Meslamtaea on the floor beside her and the other resting on its arm. Her black dress, pale-blue ribbons and golden tiara surround blonde twintails and a lonely, restrained red-eyed welcome. The wide view follows the throne into the dark hall. Drifting blue soul fires illuminate the spear and ribbon edges, leaving deep recesses behind the throne's carved structure.
